comment: Shipped analysis profiles. A profile is 'how I analyze this kind of case' — the plugins to enable, an optional starter watchlist, and a dashboard of widgets. SQL widgets use {{evtx}} / {{header_set:Name}} placeholders that bind to whichever table matches that header set in the open case, so the dashboard is portable. Shipped profiles are read-only; Save-as-profile creates editable copies.

profiles.name: KAPE triage
profiles.description: Windows host triage from KAPE/EvtxECmd output — logon movement, failed-logon spikes, RDP and explicit-credential use, host facts, log-tampering signals, and (if a RECmd batch is imported) registry persistence. Seeds a starter IOC watchlist.

query.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteHost) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4624' AND RemoteHost NOT IN ('-','','- (-)')
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) AS hr, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId IN ('4624','4625','4648') AND TimeCreated <> '' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr
SELECT RemoteHost, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4624' AND RemoteHost NOT IN ('-','','- (-)') GROUP BY RemoteHost ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT UserName, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4624' AND UserName <> '' GROUP BY UserName ORDER BY c ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel LIKE '%TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager%' AND EventId IN ('21','24','25')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Computer) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Computer NOT IN ('','-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserName) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE UserName NOT IN ('','-')
SELECT 'First event' AS k, MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) AS v FROM {{evtx}} UNION ALL SELECT 'Last event', MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) FROM {{evtx}}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%\Run' OR KeyPath LIKE '%\RunOnce' OR KeyPath LIKE '%\Services%' OR Category LIKE '%Run%' OR Category LIKE '%Service%'
SELECT Category AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{registry}} WHERE Category NOT IN ('','-') GROUP BY Category ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
